svg.title: Substitution keeps the area and changes the limits
svg.desc: Left: the graph of y = 2x cos(x squared) from x = 0 to the square root of pi/2, about 1.25, with the region under it shaded; its area is 1. Right: the graph of y = cos u from u = 0 to pi/2, about 1.57, with the region under it shaded; its area is also 1. With u = x squared, the x-limits 0 and the square root of pi/2 become the u-limits 0 and pi/2.

text.tspan: = π/2. Same area, new variable, new limits.
